InitialDialog.dialog: Hey! You in the ship?! CAN YOU HEAR ME?!
You know how to steer that thing?! Come pick me up!

EndingDialog.dialog: Thanks for the pickup! I just bailed out of a crash. REDZ clipped my tailfin like it was rush hour!
Lucky for me, I always bring my bike. Crash a plane? Fine. Lose my bike? Never.
Listen, pilot — REDZ are crawling all over these systems. Stick with me, and I’ll show you the best routes… Just don’t ask me to stop pedaling.
